reviews.conclusion: Two short options-menu visits during bastion gameplay occupy approximately 0.75-1.75 s in total, compatible with the -1.4 s deficit. Difficulty labels visibly change during the first visit. No exact native-frame residual was measured.

Portal terrain loading is followed by pause/options/video-settings screens for approximately 1.0-1.5 s, compatible with -1.2833 s. A subsequent narrow game-window phase shows changing stronghold views and is not automatically counted as a pause.

After the portal transition, two options/pause visits occupy approximately 0.75-1.75 s in total, compatible with -1.2 s. The game becomes narrow/obscured between them, so exact pause duration remains uncertain.

At End entry, an options/video-settings sequence lasts approximately 0.75-1.25 s, compatible with the -1.0833 s deficit. Subsequent inventory use is recorded as gameplay context rather than automatically counted as paused GUI time.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
